purpose: Design document defining the abstraction of the four forge wrapper SKILLs (query/update for rules and specs) that delegate document search and index updates to external backends.
summary: Overview: forge delegates document search and index updating to doc-link and doc-db backends via wrapper SKILLs
Skill list: query-db-rules, query-db-specs, update-db-rules, update-db-specs with fixed categories and user-invocable true
Query skills: task argument, execution flow with backend order resolution and availability check, no grep fallback
Query output contract: Required documents path list built by script, common across backends
Query SKILL contract: inherited-type search SKILL, allowed-tools restrictions, args limited to keywords and short task description
Update skills: optional --backend override without fallback, otherwise ordered selection, then backend-specific index update
Desired state: .doc_structure.yaml is the source of truth for target set; paths not included are removed from the index
Prerequisites: at least one backend must be usable, judged by required capability rather than version
Test design: unit tests, lints, AI-Linter checks, and wrapper transparency tests mapped to the design
tasks: Modifying query-db-rules or query-db-specs SKILL behavior
Modifying update-db-rules or update-db-specs SKILL behavior
Designing or reviewing document search backend integration
Writing or updating tests and lints for query/update wrapper SKILLs
Defining SKILL output contracts and allowed-tools for search SKILLs
Delegating index maintenance from query to update skills
title: DES-001 文書検索ラッパー（forge → 文書検索 backend）設計書
